title: c-Wise Independent Round Keys for KAF Security
summary: The paper’s results do not settle whether c-wise independent round keys are desirable or sufficient for KAF security.

formal_statement.body: For a $cn$-bit main key, determine whether $c$-wise independent round keys are desirable or sufficient for KAF security.

scope.domain: This concerns probabilistic key-schedule design for key-alternating Feistel ciphers.
parameters: c: sets the independence order and, with n, the cn-bit main-key length
n: contributes to the cn-bit main-key length
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether c-wise independent round keys are desirable or sufficient for KAF security with a cn-bit main key.

citations.label: Revisiting Key-Alternating Feistel Ciphers for Shorter Keys and Multi-user Security

progress.summary: The source explicitly conjectures that c-wise independent round keys are desirable for a cn-bit main key. It says the paper’s results do not reveal this and leaves the issue as future work.
citation_labels: Chun Guo et al., Revisiting Key-Alternating Feistel Ciphers for Shorter Keys and Multi-user Security
